reviews.snippet:
One spot where we doesn't miss at Friday nighout to airport bck home.
Their parathas are really good and tempting. They serve wide types of parathas, freshly made and served hot with butter, curd and achar.

All time favorites is paneer paratha.
The service is good. But price is quite high, but due to highway it's more.
The chaas is also very good and is done according to our needs.

Chilling outdoor is best experience at night is really good with ur frnds and family. They do have a restroom, quite neatly maintained.

reviews.snippet:
A place with good ambience and location, this place has a good range of north indian food with enough parking and seats. Garlic naan is a must, I tried it today and I'm definitely going to order it again the next time. The reason I cut a star is due to slow serving time.
Safety precautions were okay, the male restroom was clean enough. This place is worth a visit and I'd give 3.5 stars
